svg.title: Funding Yield by Equipment Lead Source
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-equipment-lead-source-yield; chapter number: 4; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Funding Yield by Equipment Lead Source; subtitle: Percent of applications or leads that fund or close; total range: Near 0% to 50% funded or closed, depending on the source; caption: Dealer partnerships fund a far larger share of applications than bought leads or broad ad campaigns.; assumptions note: Percentages are converted directly from stated ratios. The dealer figure is 4-5 of 10; the shared-lead high end is one deal on 20 leads; the ad-campaign figure is the 'not even .01' Cheathem quoted.; note: Sources are Jermane Cheathem via Credit Suite, Josh Feinberg of Leads For Locals, and Equipment Finance Academy.; buckets: label: Dealer partnerships; low: 40; high: 50; notes: 4-5 funded out of 10 weekly dealer applications (Cheathem); label: Exclusive bought leads; low: 3; high: 5; notes: $50 per lead, 30-lead minimum at $1,500 a month (Feinberg); label: Shared bought leads; low: 0; high: 5; notes: $40-80 per lead; $800 for 20 leads might close one deal; label: Broad ad campaign; low: 0; high: 0.01; notes: 100 applications a day funded 'not even .01' (Cheathem's partner)
